info.name: Gym API (Laravel)
info.description:
REST API for a sports club built with Laravel 11, JWT auth and role-based access.

**Quick start**

1. Start the API: `php artisan serve`.
2. Run **Auth → Login as Admin** first. The test script stores `access_token` in the `{{token}}` collection variable.
3. Create resources in dependency order: Rooms → Coaches → Plans → Members → Classes → Subscriptions → Payments → Registrations → Attendances.
4. Create requests save the new ID into collection variables (`{{room_id}}`, `{{plan_id}}`, `{{class_id}}`, ...), so later requests work without manual edits.

**Demo accounts** (password `password`):
- `admin@gym.test` — admin
- `manager@gym.test` — manager
- `client@gym.test` — client

**Conventions**
- Every `index` endpoint supports filtering, sorting (`sort`, `direction`) and pagination (`page`, `per_page`, max 100).
- JWT is sent as `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.
- Dates use `YYYY-MM-DD`; class times use `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss`.

See `README.md` and `PROJECT.md` in the repository for setup and domain documentation.

item.name: Auth

request.description:
Creates a client account plus a linked member profile. Returns a JWT and stores it in `{{token}}`.

Email must be unique — change it between runs. Throttled to 5 requests per minute.
Logs in as the demo admin account and stores the JWT in `{{token}}`. All other requests use the collection-level Bearer auth.
Logs in as the demo manager account and stores the JWT in `{{token}}`. All other requests use the collection-level Bearer auth.
Logs in as the demo client account and stores the JWT in `{{token}}`. All other requests use the collection-level Bearer auth.
Returns the authenticated user and the linked member profile (for clients).
Rotates the JWT. The previous token is blacklisted and the new one is stored in `{{token}}`.
Invalidates the current JWT.

item.description: Registration, login, token refresh and logout. Login requests save the JWT to `{{token}}`.

item.name: Users (Admin only)

request.description: Admin only. Filters: `role` (admin/manager/client), `search` (name or email), `sort` (id/name/email/role), `direction`, `per_page`, `page`.
Admin only. Creates a user with an explicit role. Client accounts get a linked member profile.
Returns a user with the linked member profile.
Updates name, email or password. Role changes use the dedicated endpoint below.
Admin only. Allowed roles: `admin`, `manager`, `client`. You cannot change your own role.
Admin only. You cannot delete your own account.

item.description: User provisioning and role management. All endpoints require the admin role.

item.name: Coaches

request.description: Filters: `name`, `phone`, `with_classes` (1/0), `sort` (coach_id/name), `direction`, `per_page`, `page`. Each item includes `classes_count`.
Managers and admins can create coaches. The new ID is stored in `{{coach_id}}`.
Returns the coach with their classes.
Partial update is supported; omitted fields stay unchanged.
Admin only.

item.description: Trainers. Create/update: manager or admin. Delete: admin only.

item.name: Members

request.description: Filters: `name`, `phone`, `join_date_from`, `join_date_to`, `active` (has a non-expired subscription), `sort` (member_id/name/join_date), `direction`, `per_page`, `page`.
Creates a member profile. `join_date` defaults to today when omitted. The new ID is stored in `{{member_id}}`.
Returns the member with subscriptions and registered classes.
Staff can update any member; a client can update only their own profile.
Admin only. Related subscriptions, registrations and attendances are deleted by cascade.

item.description: Club members. Managers/admins manage all members; clients can view and update their own profile.

item.name: Membership Plans

request.description: Filters: `name`, `price_min`, `price_max`, `duration_min`, `duration_max`, `is_active`, `sort` (plan_id/name/duration_days/price/is_active), `direction`, `per_page`, `page`. Each item includes `subscriptions_count`.
Managers and admins can create plans. The new ID is stored in `{{plan_id}}`.
Returns the plan with its subscriptions and members.
Deactivating a plan prevents new subscriptions but keeps existing ones.
Admin only. Existing subscriptions keep working with a null `plan_id`.

item.description: Subscription plans. A plan defines price and duration used by new subscriptions.

item.name: Subscriptions

request.description: Filters: `member_id`, `plan_id`, `price_min`, `price_max`, `start_date_from/to`, `end_date_from/to`, `active`, `sort` (sub_id/member_id/plan_id/start_date/end_date/price), `direction`, `per_page`, `page`.

When `plan_id` is provided, `price` and `end_date` are derived from the plan (`start_date + duration_days`). Explicit values override the plan. Inactive plans are rejected. The new ID is stored in `{{sub_id}}`.
Returns the subscription with its member, plan and payments.
Updates dates, price or plan. Omitting `price`/`end_date` while sending `plan_id` recalculates them from the plan.
Deletes the subscription and its payments (cascade).

item.description: Club subscriptions. Each subscription belongs to a member and optionally to a membership plan.

item.name: Payments

request.description: Filters: `sub_id`, `status` (pending/completed/failed/overdue), `method` (cash/card/online/transfer), `amount_min/max`, `payment_date_from/to`, `sort` (payment_id/amount/payment_date/status), `direction`, `per_page`, `page`.
Managers and admins can record payments. The cron command `payments:mark-overdue` flips old pending payments to `overdue`. The new ID is stored in `{{payment_id}}`.
Returns the payment with its subscription and member.
Updates payment status or method. Allowed statuses: pending, completed, failed, overdue.
Admin only.

item.description: Subscription payments. A daily cron marks stale pending payments as overdue.

item.name: Rooms

request.description: Filters: `name`, `capacity_min/max`, `with_equipment` (1/0), `with_classes` (1/0), `sort` (room_id/name/capacity), `direction`, `per_page`, `page`. Each item includes `equipment_count` and `classes_count`.
Managers and admins can create rooms. The new ID is stored in `{{room_id}}`.
Returns the room with its equipment and scheduled classes.
A room cannot be shrunk below the largest class already scheduled in it.
Admin only. Classes and equipment keep existing with a null `room_id`.

item.description: Club rooms. Each room has a capacity and hosts classes and equipment.

item.name: Equipment

request.description: Filters: `name`, `condition` (excellent/good/fair/broken), `room_id`, `quantity_min`, `sort` (equipment_id/name/quantity/condition), `direction`, `per_page`, `page`.
Managers and admins can add equipment. The new ID is stored in `{{equipment_id}}`.
Returns the item with its room.
Updates quantity, condition or room.
Admin only.

item.description: Club equipment. Every item optionally belongs to a room.

item.name: Classes

request.description: Filters: `title`, `coach_id`, `room_id`, `class_time_from/to`, `capacity_min/max`, `available` (1/0), `sort` (class_id/title/class_time/capacity), `direction`, `per_page`, `page`. Each item includes `members_count`.
Managers and admins can schedule classes. The capacity must not exceed the room capacity. The new ID is stored in `{{class_id}}`.
Returns the class with its coach, room and registered members.
Capacity is validated against the assigned room.
Deletes the class and its registrations and attendances (cascade). Manager or admin.

item.description: Group classes. Each class has a coach, a room, a time and a capacity.

item.name: Registrations

request.description: Staff only. Filters: `member_id`, `class_id`, `sort` (member_id/class_id), `direction`, `per_page`, `page`.
Registrations of one member.
Registrations for one class.
Registers a member for a class. Checks duplicates and class capacity. Clients may register only their own member profile.
Registrations are keyed by the `(member_id, class_id)` pair.
Moves a registration to another class. The new class must have free capacity and must not already contain this member. Update `{{target_class_id}}` to the destination class.
Removes the registration. Clients can cancel only their own registrations.

item.description: Member registrations for classes (many-to-many pivot with capacity rules).

item.name: Attendances

request.description: Filters: `member_id`, `class_id`, `status` (present/absent/late), `checked_in_from/to`, `sort` (attendance_id/status/checked_in_at), `direction`, `per_page`, `page`.
Records attendance. The member must already be registered for the class. `checked_in_at` defaults to now for present/late. The new ID is stored in `{{attendance_id}}`.
Returns the attendance with member and class details.
Updates status or notes. Use `absent` to mark a no-show.
Admin only.

item.description: Actual class visits. Attendance requires an existing registration.

item.name: Pagination Examples

request.description: Standard paginated response: `data`, `current_page`, `per_page`, `total`, `last_page` and navigation URLs.
Filtering and pagination combined: only classes with free seats, sorted by time.
Filter by attendance status and paginate.

item.description: Examples of `page` / `per_page` combined with filters and sorting.
